scope: Fix the actual fd0215d Mac producer timeout cleanup failure without changing codesign identity/trust/fixture gates. Two future source files only; no canonical or CI changes.

actualFailure.rootCause: After communicate TimeoutExpired the immediate TERM then group KILL sequence raised PermissionError EPERM at the second signal, bypassing drain/reap and surfacing the raw TimeoutExpired command chain. ResourceWarnings record unreaped Popen/open pipes.

facts.meaning: communicate timeout does not terminate the child; cleanup must signal and finish communication. TimeoutExpired retains the original command.
EPERM is an actual permission error, distinct from ESRCH; it cannot simply count as successful termination.

This public XNU source excludes SZOMB in process-group iteration and returns POSIX EPERM when no signalable member is counted. TERM-to-zombie before immediate KILL is a source-supported explanation, not a measured runtime kernel/process-state diagnosis.

implementation: At hard deadline, issue one SIGKILL to this tool-owned process group before reaping; no preliminary TERM or repeated group signal. The group originates solely from Popen(start_new_session=True).
Always perform bounded communication (1 second), close owned pipes, and bounded wait/reap (0.5 seconds), keeping independent drain/reap/pipe and safe issue facts. No wait searches other processes.

A genuine group signaling error remains a typed ToolProcessFailure with sanitized stage/type/errno and non-success status. A direct KILL only to the same unreaped leader attempts to prevent its leak; it does not claim group termination.

Raw TimeoutExpired/OSError cmd/message/filename are never formatted or chained into published private diagnostics. Private stdout/stderr/importer partial status remain suppressed; new safe failures are raised from None outside raw handlers.
Original global300/per-tool/cleanup10-second budgets, independent cleanup deadline, actual codesign/CMS requirements, owned Keychain/trust/searchlist boundaries remain unchanged.

newFaultScenarios: injected group EPERM around a real owned child
injected drain TimeoutExpired around a real owned child
injected communicate OSError around a real owned child

independentStaticReview.scope: bounded_child/run current two-source draft; no edit or execution
independentStaticReview.notes: Confirmed single pre-reap hard signal; genuine group/drain/reap errors stay failed, safe issue schema excludes command/message/filename, private streams stay unpublished and raw timeout cause is suppressed.

limits: Local execution proves Windows owned-child/error/privacy regressions only. The new macOS process-group behavior and codesign producer remain unexecuted until the next concentrated source-bound job.

If the OS genuinely denies all permitted termination, no broader kill or privilege change is attempted. Unreaped/undrained facts remain explicit failure; group EPERM is never treated as ESRCH or success.
communicate still buffers child output in memory; this change does not claim a streaming memory bound. Windows does not receive a POSIX process-group guarantee.
The public XNU source is preserved by raw SHA; it is not asserted to be the exact kernel revision of the historical runner.
No account/Keychain secret, real IPA or private source was read; no trust settings/searchlist or user/system process was changed.
